successor_rules.name: Abandoned Plan Retirement
successor_rules.description: Retirement kind 'abandoned' transitions state to 'cancelled' with no successor reference.
successor_rules.contract: successor_ref must be None; state becomes cancelled; history preserved

successor_rules.name: Superseded Plan Retirement
successor_rules.description: Retirement kind 'superseded' requires exact eligible successor_ref and transitions state to 'superseded'.
successor_rules.contract: successor_ref must be valid, initialized, non-self, non-retired Plan; state becomes superseded

successor_rules.name: Active / Current Plan Protection
successor_rules.description: Active or current plans are protected from retirement until deactivated.

successor_rules.name: Running Task Protection
successor_rules.description: Plans with active running tasks cannot be retired.

successor_rules.name: Stage-One Snapshot Binding
successor_rules.description: Stage-two retirement request must bind to fresh stage-one candidate snapshot.
successor_rules.contract: Stale snapshot fails closed with RETIREMENT_STALE_SNAPSHOT

successor_rules.name: No Heuristic Successor Selection
successor_rules.description: System never guesses or auto-selects a successor when multiple candidates exist.

successor_rules.name: No Implicit Resurrection
successor_rules.description: Retired, cancelled, or superseded plans cannot be re-initialized or un-retired.
